advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Gate/adjust `provenance_for` on the `model_override` path so provenance does not claim a real provider/model/first_class tier for a TestModel run (mirror the `ran_model` marker).
evidence: runner.py:318-320: `ran_model = (f"test:{type(self._model_override).__name__}" if self._model_override else resolved)`

runner.py:372-374: `provider_provenance = provenance_for(provider=_provider_name, model=resolved, base_url=cfg.base_url, caps=caps)` — called with `resolved`/`_provider_name` unconditionally, not gated on `_model_override`
runner.py:610-611: `model=ran_model, provider_provenance=provider_provenance` — the two fields disagree on the model when model_override is set
capabilities.py:278: `"tier": "best_effort" if base_url else "first_class"` — a TestModel run with no base_url gets first_class
advisory.finding: On the offline `model_override` (TestModel) path, `provider_provenance` is stamped with the REAL resolved provider/model and `tier=first_class`, while the sibling `model` field is set to the `test:<ClassName>` marker — so the provenance record falsely attributes a test-double run to e.g. `anthropic:claude-opus-4-8` at `first_class` tier, exactly the false-attribution this change exists to prevent. `ran_model` is deliberately branched to a test marker but `provenance_for` is called unconditionally with `resolved`/`_provider_name`/`caps` and is not gated on `self._model_override`.
scenarios: Any offline test/harness run using `PydanticAIRunner(model_override=...)` whose result is persisted into a sidecar payload
A stored verdict comparison where `model` says `test:FunctionModel` but `provider_provenance.model` claims `anthropic:claude-opus-4-8`
advisory.suggested_fix: Skip provenance (or stamp a `test`/`unknown` provider marker) when `self._model_override is not None`, e.g. `provider_provenance = None if self._model_override is not None else provenance_for(...)`, mirroring how `ran_model` already substitutes a test marker.
